stem.en: Water flows in a straight line at uniform speed with no swirling. What can be said about the curl of its velocity field?
stem.et: Vesi voolab sirgjooneliselt ühtlase kiirusega ilma keerlemiseta. Mida saab öelda selle kiirusvälja rootori kohta?

label.en: It is zero — curl measures local rotation, and there is none here
label.et: See on null — rootor mõõdab kohalikku pöörlemist ja seda siin ei ole

label.en: It must be large, since the water is clearly moving
label.et: See peab olema suur, sest vesi liigub selgelt

label.en: It is the same as the divergence, since they measure the same thing
label.et: See on sama mis divergents, sest need mõõdavad sama asja

label.en: It cannot be evaluated for a field with no swirling
label.et: Seda ei saa hinnata väljal, kus keerlemist pole
